blocks.title: Three TV games · Bingo, Gauntlet, Roulette
blocks.dek: Cast a URL to a TV. Every visitor in the room is a Noun on screen. Bingo: 5×5 cards auto-mark on /api/sounds events. Gauntlet: 60-second tap race up vertical lanes. Roulette: spinning wheel of present Nouns picks a leader every 30 seconds.
